introStrip: Independent animal nutrition consultancy — The Netherlands

species.title: All Major Animal Categories
species.intro: From fish and shrimp to ruminants — broad, cross-species experience means advice that travels across production systems, not just within one. Hover or tap a card to see example species.

highlights.title: Nutritional Advisory
highlights.text: Evidence-based feed formulation and dietary advice for all production species, from feasibility to final ration.

highlights.title: On-Site Technical Support
highlights.text: Hands-on support at client facilities — from feed mill audits to ration troubleshooting and Bestmix system setup.

highlights.title: Additives & Raw Materials
highlights.text: Feasibility studies for additives including enzymes, yeasts, SCFA, MCFA, and mycotoxin binders. As well as raw materials and wet & dry co-product evaluation.

highlights.title: Courses & Training
highlights.text: Customer-specific courses on raw material knowledge, additive science, and Bestmix formulation — delivered on-site or remotely.

cta.title: Looking for independent nutrition advice?
cta.text: Get in touch to discuss your challenge — no obligation, no sales pitch.
